correctness.rationale: The normalization and shift t=k+1, z=t+w give w³+3tw−2t=0. The real root r lies in (1/2,2/3) for every t≥1. The conjugate pair has squared modulus exceeding R² by 3t(1−r). Independently expanding the squared residue comparison gives (9/4)[t²(4−4r−r²)+tr²(1−3r)−r⁴]; substituting t=r³/(2−3r) gives the stated factorization, positive since r³−4r²+10r−4 is increasing and equals 1/8 at 1/2. Thus A>2|B| and the strict coefficient bound includes n=0. For finite nonnegative X, spectral-radius convergence and the constant coefficient plus positive path terms give the claimed inverse and irreducible strict positivity. On a Perron eigenvector the series terms do not tend to zero for ρ(X)≥R; at equality q(X) annihilates that vector. No positivity is asserted beyond convergence, for signed matrices, or for the full Padé approximant. Frozen RESULT.md lines 16–86 carry the proof. The inspected verifier was not executed; the separate exact Fraction recurrence in lines 92–97 reproduced 484 assertions (positivity at n=1,…,60 and reciprocal convolution at n=0,…,60 for k=0,…,3). That finite diagnostic is not the proof.
